name: M0 RoboLab setup + benchmark integrity
notes: No sudo on this box; fixed missing system libs (libGLU/libSM/libXt) via local provisioner API instead. Also had to override UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR for later envs.

name: M1 Cosmos3-Edge B=1 smoke
notes: openpi_client missing from RoboLab deps, installed manually with uv pip (no pip binary in uv venv). Dream video geometry (33,528,640,3) confirmed empirically via ffprobe, matches robometer bootstrap notes prediction.

name: M2 Robometer-4B offline validation
notes: torchao 0.18.0 (transitive) incompatible with torch 2.8.0, fixed with torchao<0.10 pinned to 0.9.0. Dream-right view collapsed to near-zero on final chunk only -- flagged as real anomaly for M5, not dismissed.

name: M3 Robometer-only Best-of-K vs random vs first-sample
notes: n=1 episode per arm -- step-count ordering (robometer<random<first) is suggestive, not statistically confirmatory. Selector correctness fully verified by cross-checking decision log against saved dream-file tags at all 19 decisions.

name: M4 DROID IDM: 500-episode training
notes: Scaled from RUN_0008 27-episode debug subset (val_mean_joint_mae=0.516) to 500 episodes: ~7.5x improvement. Recipe (full 33-frame density, BCE+pos_weight gripper loss, grad clip, OneCycleLR) confirmed to scale cleanly. One SIGBUS crash mid-run from a race with concurrent preprocess_videos.py background download overwriting an mmapped cache file -- fixed with atomic write-then-rename. No git repo for wise_idm yet -- flagged, not yet fixed. 5000-episode download and a wide-model architecture comparison (RUN_0010) still running in parallel.

name: M4 DROID IDM: wide/deep model capacity comparison

metrics.result: baseline (9.0M params) beats wide (23.8M params) by ~17% relative -- data-limited, not capacity-limited, at 500 episodes

notes: Ran concurrently with RUN_0009 on GPU1 (proactive GPU utilization). Found and fixed a real reproducibility bug: checkpoint config dict omitted architecture hyperparameters, causing verify_checkpoint.py to reconstruct the wrong-shaped model on reload -- fixed in train.py/verify_checkpoint.py and patched into both existing checkpoints. Baseline architecture carried forward as the reference config for M5 and any future retrain.

name: M4 DROID IDM: 5000-episode training, 15 epochs (batch=16/lr=3e-4)
notes: Underperformed RUN_0009 (500ep, 0.06857) despite ~3x more total gradient steps -- diagnosed as underfitting from insufficient epoch budget (15 passes over 5000ep vs RUN_0009s 40 passes over 500ep), not a generalization gap or capacity issue. Superseded by RUN_0015.

name: M4 DROID IDM: 5000-episode training, 15 epochs (batch=32/lr=5e-4 variant)
notes: Matched RUN_0012 closely (0.1238 vs 0.1256) -- ruled out batch/lr as the explanation for the plateau, pointing at epoch budget instead. Superseded by RUN_0015.

name: M4 DROID IDM: wide model at 5000ep scale (aborted, redesigned)
notes: Killed before epoch 0 completed (zero sunk training cost) after user feedback that testing capacity at the same insufficient 15-epoch budget was a weak test. Redesigned as RUN_0015: combined-GPU DDP run, baseline architecture, 30 epochs.

name: M4 DROID IDM: 5000-episode training, DDP both GPUs, 30 epochs (final attempt)
notes: Best of all 5000ep attempts (beat RUN_0012 0.1256 and RUN_0013 0.1238), and epoch budget confirmed as a real factor -- but even with a properly matched budget and genuine convergence, still worse than RUN_0009s 500ep result (0.06857). RUN_0009 remains the best checkpoint overall. Motivates architecture redesign (spatial-softmax token compression, vision-only, no proprio token) rather than further data/epoch scaling of the current architecture.

name: M5 DROID IDM: dream-video inference sanity test
notes: First real test of the IDM on genuinely imagined (Cosmos-generated) video rather than real DROID frames. Gripper predictions correctly track episode phase (open during approach, closing during grasp) on both tested chunks; joint velocities stay within Franka hardware limits on both. Qualitative pass -- no ground truth exists for a dream video, so this is a plausibility check, not an accuracy measurement.

config.input: 3 RGB views x 33 consecutive frames at 15 Hz
config.output: 32 x (7 absolute joint positions + 1 binary gripper)
config.selection: 21000 train / 1000 validation; eligible lab x outcome quotas; raw-scene-disjoint; no test split

name: M4 production three-view vision-only IDM
notes: Production code and focused CPU contract tests are implemented. Manifest generation, shard preprocessing, two-A100 training, fixed-1K reload verification, and the production checkpoint remain pending. Legacy checkpoints are not compatible evidence for this architecture.
